clinical_hypothesis: Loss of effective serratus anterior function produces medial scapular winging and altered scapulothoracic kinematics.
relevance: Classic neurological-clinical finding in long thoracic nerve injury (e.g. radical mastectomy, trauma).

clinical_hypothesis: Compression of the suprascapular nerve at the suprascapular notch causes supraspinatus and infraspinatus weakness and wasting.
relevance: Entrapment neuropathy affecting abduction initiation and external shoulder rotation.

clinical_hypothesis: Compression of the suprascapular nerve in the spinoglenoid notch region spares the supraspinatus and isolatedly denervates the infraspinatus.
relevance: Overhead athletes (volleyball, baseball) developing selective external rotator weakness.

clinical_hypothesis: Relative shallowness of the glenoid fossa relies on the labrum and capsule for static stability; labral detachment predisposes to recurrent dislocation.
relevance: Bankart lesions and glenohumeral joint instability.

clinical_hypothesis: Scapular peri-osseous anastomotic network provides collateral pathways around proximal axillary artery ligation or occlusion.
relevance: Vascular surgery and collateral limb perfusion preservation.
